article.body: Researchers at Hong Kong University of Science and Technology have introduced SatNav, a scalable, long-horizon UAV Vision-Language Navigation benchmark built from high-resolution satellite imagery. The benchmark targets city-level navigation missions and uses satellite crops as approximations of UAV nadir views for visual observations. The development was accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track (Poster).
